SELECT orders.location_id, locations.location_name, SUM(order_items.product_price) AS revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS order_items
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."locations" AS locations ON orders.location_id = locations.location_id
GROUP BY orders.location_id, locations.location_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 500
